items.description: One Know Be4 response data record.

campaign_id.description: Unique ID of the phishing campaign.

create_date.description: Date and time the campaign was created.

difficulty_filter.description: An array indicating what difficulty level(s) of phishing templates were chosen on the campaign, from 1 - 5

frequency.description: How often the phishing campaign is configured to run.

groups.description: An array of groups targeted by the phishing campaign, including group name and id.

hidden.description: Indicates if the campaign has been hidden from reports (True = Hidden)

last_phish_prone_percentage.description: Last phish-prone percentage on the campaign, shown in decimal format (Example: 0.2 = 20%).

last_run.description: Date and time of the last phishing security test in the campaign.

psts.description: An array of all phishing security tests in the campaign, includes basic data about each phishing security test.

psts_count.description: Number of phishing security tests in the campaign.

send_duration.description: Duration of time the campaign will send phishing emails.

track_duration.description: Duration of time the campaign will track phishing security test failures after the final phishing email is sent.

content_type.description: Indicates that the item is an uploaded policy.

minimum_time.description: Minimum number of minutes that the user is required to review the policy. (Null = No minimum time required)

status.description: Indicates if the policy is currently Drafted, Published, or Archived. 0 = Draft 1 = Published 2 = Archived

pst_id.description: Unique ID of the phishing security test.

qr_code_scanned_count.description: Number of users who scanned a QR code.

reported_count.description: Number of users who reported the email using the Phish Alert Button.

scheduled_count.description: Number of users who were scheduled to receive phishing emails.

started_at.description: Date and time the phishing security test started.

status.description: Status of the phishing security test.
